meta_description: Landscape South Birmingham delivers expert garden design, maintenance, and landscaping across Birmingham. Free quotes, friendly service. Call today.
hero_subhead: Whether you need a complete garden redesign or regular maintenance, our team handles every job with care and attention.
services_subhead: From design and planting to ongoing maintenance and tree work, we handle every aspect of your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Custom garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create stunning landscapes that maximise your outdoor living, whether you want a modern courtyard or traditional borders.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal care to keep your garden looking sharp year-round. We work to your schedule—weekly, fortnightly, or monthly.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Durable patios, raised decking, and pathway work using quality materials. Perfect for creating outdoor entertaining spaces that last.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Professional tree felling, limb removal, stump grinding, and careful pruning. All debris cleared and responsibly disposed of.

services.title: Landscape Construction
services.desc: Brickwork, retaining walls, raised beds, water features, and garden structures. We build gardens that are both beautiful and functional.

services.title: Spring & Autumn Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Seasonal deep cleans including leaf clearance, bedding refresh, and garden preparation. Get your garden ready for the season ahead.

about_pullquote: I started this business because every garden deserves care and attention to detail.
about_para_1: Landscape South Birmingham has served South Birmingham homeowners and businesses for over 15 years. What began as a small family operation has grown into a trusted team delivering hundreds of garden transformations annually. We combine traditional gardening skills with modern design ideas to create outdoor spaces our customers love.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, quality workmanship, and genuine care for your garden. We turn up on time, clean up thoroughly, and listen to what you actually want—not what we think you should have. Customers return to us again and again because we treat every garden like it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant lads. Came and cleared our overgrown garden, built a raised bed, and turfed the whole lawn. Couldn't believe the transformation. Tidy workers, fair price, and they finished bang on schedule. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using Landscape South for three years now. They come round every other week to keep the garden maintained. Professional, friendly, and they always notice little jobs that need doing. Best decision I made.
reviews.author: Linda K.

reviews.text: Called them for a free quote after getting ripped off by another gardener. They were honest about what the job needed, gave a fair price, and the work was immaculate. Great team to have around. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David R.
